title: Daily Devotional #26
paragraphs: As I read Matthew chapter 26, I am struck by the depth of emotions that Jesus experienced in the hours leading up to His arrest, trial, and crucifixion. The chapter opens with Jesus telling His disciples that the Passover meal they are about to share together will be His last before His death. He knows what lies ahead, yet He continues to love and serve His disciples to the very end.

As I reflect on Jesus' example, I am reminded of the importance of sacrificial love. Jesus' love for His disciples was so great that He willingly gave up His own life for them. I am called to love others in the same way, to put their needs above my own and to serve them with humility and grace.

But as the chapter progresses, Jesus' emotions begin to shift. He goes to the Garden of Gethsemane to pray, and there He expresses his anguish to His Father. He says, "My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death" (Matthew 26:38). Even though Jesus knows what is going to happen and is willing to face it, He is not immune to the pain and fear that come with such a great sacrifice.

Lord, as I face difficult situations in my life, help me to remember that it is okay to feel overwhelmed and afraid. Even Jesus, who was fully God and fully human, experienced these emotions. Help me to turn to You in prayer and to seek Your comfort and strength.

Finally, in Matthew 26, we see Jesus' ultimate act of obedience to His Father. He willingly submits to His arrest and trial, knowing that it will lead to His death on the cross. He does not resist or fight back, but instead He surrenders Himself to God's plan.

Lord, help me to follow Jesus' example of obedience. Give me the courage to trust in Your plan for my life, even when it is difficult or painful. Help me to surrender my will to Yours and to walk in faith and obedience, just as Jesus did.
